channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Becky Hammon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Becky Hammon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Becky Hammon
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on being selected for HOF along with Tony Parker & Becky Hammon:

“It’s kind of fun all of us doing it at once. It’s kind of weird. But kind of fun. I love them both.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Becky Hammon, Apr 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Liz Cambage on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Liz Cambage on Becky Hammon’s coaching salary in Las Vegas:

“It’s confusing to see a coach get paid a $1 million with the salary cap is rounded up to $1.4 million.… we love to see it, but we also want to understand how it can happen.”

Liz Cambage on Becky Hammon, Feb 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Neil Olshey on Becky Hammon:

“We obviously admire Becky. She did a great job. Making it as far as the owner in the process isn't easy. She made it all the way to the ownership level, which is an endorsement.”

Neil Olshey on Becky Hammon, Jun 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Becky Hammon
item.description:
DeMar DeRozan on Becky Hammon:

“She’s one of us. When she speaks, we are all ears. It’s great having her.”

DeMar DeRozan on Becky Hammon, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Becky Hammon making history:

“She’s here for a reason. ...I think she’s going to be a head coach in this league someday.”

Frank Vogel on Becky Hammon, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Kyrie Irving on Becky Hammon becoming the first woman to fill in as head coach in a regular season NBA game yesterday:

“There shouldn’t be any roles that are deemed for male or female... But there’s still a fight. I am glad Pop got ejected and put Becky at the driver’s seat.”

Kyrie Irving on Becky Hammon, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Lonnie Walker on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Lonnie Walker on Becky Hammon:

“She is one of one. She is a rare breed. What she did yesterday as a coach is impeccable, in my opinion. She came in. She was decisive. She knew what she had to do. That’s just who she is.”

Lonnie Walker on Becky Hammon, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Michael Malone on Becky Hammon:

“The NBA is blind to gender, is blind to color. I’m proud to be a part of it. .... If you know the game, you know the game.”

Michael Malone on Becky Hammon, Dec 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Danny Green on Becky Hammon
item.description:
“It was like, ‘Coach, or Coach Hammon or Becky’, she’s got some good stuff, see Becky about this or talk to her about that.”

Danny Green on Becky Hammon, Jun 7, 2020. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Sue Bird on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Sue Bird says the best part of her new gig is scouting.

“Actually Becky Hammon was one of the first people to tell me this, one of the hardest parts is just learning the personnel because there's so many players,”

Sue Bird on Becky Hammon, Feb 22, 2019. Source: Seattle Times.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Manu on Hammon:

“She’s a coach. And she is doing a great job. She is smart, she understands the game. She's just another coach we respect.”

Manu Ginobili on Becky Hammon, Oct 8, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kyle Anderson on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Kyle Anderson on Coach Hammon:

“She's a great basketball mind. She has a lot of good information to share with us, with the team.”

Kyle Anderson on Becky Hammon, Jul 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaPS.

item.title: Adam Silver on Becky Hammon
item.description:
Then there was the Spurs’ hiring of Becky Hammon as the first full-time female assistant coach in NBA history, a moment Silver singled out in a video interview with USA Today.

“I think the hiring of Becky Hammon is a wonderful step for the league,”

Adam Silver on Becky Hammon, Feb 10, 2015. Source: San Antonio Express-News.
